name: migrationhub-config
description: The AWS Migration Hub home region APIs are available specifically for working with your Migration Hub home region.

subcommands.name: create-home-region-control
subcommands.description: This API sets up the home region for the calling account only.

subcommands.name: delete-home-region-control
subcommands.description: This operation deletes the home region configuration for the calling account.

subcommands.name: describe-home-region-controls
subcommands.description: This API permits filtering on the ControlId and HomeRegion fields.

subcommands.name: get-home-region
subcommands.description: Returns the calling account’s home region, if configured.
